title: Bathtub with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='tubGrad' cx='50%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c8f0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7ac8e8'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='bubbleGrad' cx='35%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a0e8ff'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- bathtub body -->
  <path d='M12,58 L12,78 Q12,90 24,90 L76,90 Q88,90 88,78 L88,58 Z' fill='#eafaff' stroke='#a0d8f0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M12,58 L12,78 Q12,90 24,90 L76,90 Q88,90 88,78 L88,58 Z' fill='url(#tubGrad)' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- water surface -->
  <path d='M16,58 Q30,50 44,58 Q58,66 72,58 Q80,54 84,58 L84,78 Q70,70 56,78 Q42,86 28,78 Q20,74 16,78 Z' fill='#5bd6f5' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- rim highlight -->
  <rect x='10' y='55' width='80' height='6' rx='3' fill='#d0f4ff' stroke='#90cce0' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <path d='M24,90 L20,97' stroke='#80c0d8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M76,90 L80,97' stroke='#80c0d8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- faucet -->
  <rect x='42' y='38' width='6' height='18' rx='2' fill='#d8f0fa' stroke='#90cce0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M42,40 Q42,32 52,32 L56,32 Q60,32 60,36 L60,40' fill='none' stroke='#b0dcee' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <rect x='38' y='36' width='14' height='6' rx='3' fill='#c8e8f5' stroke='#90cce0' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- droplets from faucet -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='44' r='2' fill='#a0e8ff'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#a0e8ff'/>

  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='54' r='6' fill='url(#bubbleGrad)' stroke='#c0eaf8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='52' r='4' fill='url(#bubbleGrad)' stroke='#c0eaf8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='54' r='5' fill='url(#bubbleGrad)' stroke='#c0eaf8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='52' r='3' fill='url(#bubbleGrad)' stroke='#c0eaf8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='50' r='3' fill='url(#bubbleGrad)' stroke='#c0eaf8' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='70' r='5' fill='#2a6a8a'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#a0e8ff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='70' r='5' fill='#2a6a8a'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#a0e8ff'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38,80 Q50,90 62,80' fill='none' stroke='#2a6a8a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='79' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ffb0c0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='79' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ffb0c0' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- little eyebrows -->
  <path d='M31,63 Q36,59 41,63' fill='none' stroke='#4a90b0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M59,63 Q64,59 69,63' fill='none' stroke='#4a90b0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
